objective: Explore and validate mechanism-distinct unified modeling of multi-field user/context/target features and multi-feedback behavior histories. Develop representations and information flow that jointly support sequence modeling, feature interaction and task prediction under the fixed data and compute protocol. Current research question: Under the frozen inputs, history policy and training protocol, does task-mask membership improve click AUC beyond aligned historical item content and action codes in the strongest visible model, at justified parameter and measured runtime cost?
success_policy: Report model performance, mechanism evidence, and differences from prior work separately. An unsupported or unsuccessful new mechanism is a valid research outcome when faithfully documented; replication and tuning alone are not a new contribution.

dataset.name: UniRank released Taobao_Action benchmark
dataset.prediction_unit: ad impression; binary probabilities for four tasks
dataset.history: Previous ad exposures, real advertisement/category/campaign/customer/brand/price fields and feedback action tokens; fixed visibility protocol.
dataset.auxiliary_label_semantics: Any cart/fav/buy of the same user/category/brand within 24h after impression; not advertisement-specific conversion attribution.
dataset.split: Official 2017-05-06..11 train / May12 validation / May13 held out, Asia/Shanghai
limitations: Official whole-window filtering/vocabularies and publisher static snapshots are inherited benchmark assumptions. Their production point-in-time validity is not established.

rules: Find nearest methods before asserting novelty

industry.task_mismatch: Original paper tasks and benchmark reimplementations may differ from this unified-modeling task. Respect the frozen fields, histories, labels and costs.

agent.delivery: This topic's receipts and explicit imported controls only; old campaigns are not local evidence.

research_flow.entry: audit actual fields, causal availability, label prevalence, compute, existing code and complete-unit experiment cost
baseline_requirements: A reproducible DIN local-activation reference adapted to actual fields and four labels.
reference_candidates_not_prescribed: DIN establishes the initial empirical reference. Unified candidates may replace the whole model; later controls should include the closest architectural alternatives.
research_flow.question_selection: Choose a concrete observed limitation after baseline and slice diagnostics. Do not preselect a winning mechanism from the industry cards.
research_flow.nearest_work_check: Check the nearest unified architecture and mechanism, record inherited components and differences, and verify primary sources before originality claims.
attribution: lineage-aware comparison of positive, null and failed trajectories
repetitions when a direction remains consequential
research_flow.continuation: A direction may continue across multiple rounds when evidence justifies another diagnostic or implementation change; one failed implementation is not a mechanism refutation.
research_flow.screening: Optional fixed user-hash subsets and internal temporal folds are screening-only. Preserve prevalence and time boundaries; final candidates and controls use the frozen full protocol. Never compare a subset result to a full-data result as if matched.

secondary: All four tasks ROC-AUC/Logloss; auxiliary mean AUC separately
cost_views: matched training recipe/data passes for mechanism isolation
measured equal-compute or quality-cost frontier for efficiency
analysis.slice_rules: Define bins using training data or pre-experiment rules, report sample/positive/negative counts; mark insufficient slices, and distinguish exploratory from predeclared confirmatory findings.
analysis.uncertainty: Paired seeds and paired user-cluster bootstrap where feasible; repeated exposures from a user are not independent samples. Report intervals and seed variation without claiming significance from one run.

host_owned: causal feature construction and split policy
implementation_boundary.candidate_interface: Defined by the task adapter at freeze time; must return prediction logits/probabilities with fixed sample identity and information boundary.
implementation_boundary.protocol_change: Requires a new version and rerun of affected references before any new comparison; no silent changes during search.

final_assessment.repetitions: Target three paired seeds for the final candidate and closest controls when budget permits; record omitted repetitions and retain single-seed conclusions as preliminary.
final_assessment.test: Closed during autonomous research. A final suite must be frozen before any held-out scoring; no automatic test access from research loop.
final_assessment.failure: Retain failed assessment receipts; unknown execution state does not authorize automatic duplicate testing.

deliverables: best supported model code/configuration and executable reproduction commands
boundaries, unresolved questions and next hypotheses

baseline_role.purpose: Initial empirical reference and calibration point for predictive quality, diagnostics and compute cost.
baseline_role.final_model_family: Open; selected from evidence and may be a completely different architecture.
baseline_role.later_comparisons: Use the initial reference and the closest successful architectural alternatives or controls as the research progresses.

architecture_search.scope: Whole-model design, including replacement of the initial network and all internal representations.
design_dimensions: Representation units: fields, events, behavior groups, learned slots and target/task tokens.
Information flow: stacked interaction, layer-wise joint interaction, parallel exchange, learned routing or other testable unified structures.
History selection/compression jointly designed with target/context-conditioned retrieval.
Derived features computed from authorized inputs: field matches, behavior counts/composition, grouping and sequence positions.
Shared and task-conditioned representations, prediction readouts and registered training-loss mechanisms.
architecture_search.lineage: parent_trial identifies a comparison and evidence lineage; it does not require code or architectural inheritance. inherited_components may be empty when the whole model is replaced.
architecture_search.proposal_unit: A coherent mechanism hypothesis can require several coordinated structural changes. Build that structure and plan component, replacement or factorial controls to identify where its value comes from.
architecture_search.evidence: Evaluate predictive quality, mechanism support, nearest-work differences and measured cost. Compare new unified candidates against their closest architectural alternatives as well as the initial reference.
architecture_search.fixed_contracts: Available sample information, labels, data split, scoring, resource accounting and the frozen host training recipe remain shared. Internal architecture and readout design are candidate choices.
architecture_search.reference_use: UniRank comparison methods provide inspectable design references and nearest work. Agents choose and adapt mechanisms from local evidence.

research_topic.title: Conditional utility of task-mask membership
research_topic.question: Under the frozen inputs, history policy and training protocol, does task-mask membership improve click AUC beyond aligned historical item content and action codes in the strongest visible model, at justified parameter and measured runtime cost?
research_topic.hypothesis: Task-mask membership may supply useful event assignment beyond item content and historical actions; the compact evidence does not establish this. Inherit the strongest visible trial unchanged as the utility control. Compare full membership use with a membership-blind representation and a counts-only replacement to distinguish event assignment from task-history frequency. Keep host mask construction, valid history, event order, aligned item fields and actions, target inputs, supervision and training exposure fixed; representation controls must not expose padded events or alter label construction. Use matched-capacity replacements and measure training and inference cost. A valid-history membership-permutation control should preserve per-task counts and joint membership patterns while disrupting their association with event content. Full membership failing to beat these controls would undermine its conditional utility; an apparent gain explained by capacity, cost or frequency would not establish useful event assignment. Repeat a discriminating comparison before claiming support, reserving resources for attribution and assessment. This question concerns representation use of masks, distinct from changing historical actions or auxiliary-gradient participation.
